mapper.select: SELECT record_id AS recordId, user_id AS userId, reading_id AS readingId, score, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, device_type AS deviceType, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, answer_evaluation AS answerEvaluation, read_summary_id AS readSummaryId FROM COL_USER_ANSWER_RECORD WHERE record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT record_id AS recordId, user_id AS userId, reading_id AS readingId, score, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, device_type AS deviceType, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, answer_evaluation AS answerEvaluation, read_summary_id AS readSummaryId FROM COL_USER_ANSWER_RECORD WHERE read_summary_id = #{readSummaryId} AND (score is null OR score = 0)

SELECT user.record_id AS recordId, user.user_id AS userId, user.reading_id AS readingId, user.score, user.duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, user.device_type AS deviceType, user.created_at AS createdAt, user.updated_at AS updatedAt, user.answer_evaluation AS answerEvaluation, user.read_summary_id AS readSummaryId, summary.COL_TITLE AS title FROM COL_USER_ANSWER_RECORD user LEFT JOIN col_reading_summary summary ON user.read_summary_id = summary.COL_ID WHERE user.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT record_id AS recordId, user_id AS userId, reading_id AS readingId, score, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, device_type AS deviceType, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, answer_evaluation AS answerEvaluation, read_summary_id AS readSummaryId FROM COL_USER_ANSWER_RECORD WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND user_id = #{userId}
